working_definition: Cyst cells of the adult testis in an intermediate state between early and later cyst cell clusters; no marker or stage description. Authors had no FBbt term (Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_definition: One of a pair of somatic cells that envelope each cyst of developing male germline cells.

justification: 'Intermediate' is a lineage-state label with no FBbt equivalent; the cell type is a testis cyst cell.
recommendation: Broad match to cyst cell of testis.
